summary: My (and mine) is a flat open hand placed on the chest. The flat hand is what makes it possessive; a pointing finger would be I.
steps: Place a flat hand, palm in, against your chest.
Hold it a moment. For emphasis ('mine!'), tap firmly.
Use it before the noun: MY NAME, MY SISTER, MY HOUSE.
mistakes: Using an index finger. That's I/ME. Possessives use the flat hand.
